CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFINDEX

CFINDEX fills a collection with searchable text. It can index the files of a directory, a single file, or "custom" data: a literal string or every row of a query, which is how you make a database searchable with CFSEARCH.

Category

Verity search

Syntax

<CFINDEX COLLECTION="collection_name"
    ACTION="action"
    TYPE="type"
    KEY="key"
    TITLE="title"
    BODY="body"
    CUSTOM1="value"
    CUSTOM2="value"
    URLPATH="URL"
    EXTENSIONS="file_extensions"
    QUERY="query_name"
    RECURSE="Yes/No"
    EXTERNAL="Yes/No"
    LANGUAGE="English">

Attributes

COLLECTION
Required. Name of an existing collection (see CFCOLLECTION).
ACTION
Required. UPDATE adds documents or replaces those with the same key; DELETE removes documents by key; PURGE empties the collection; REFRESH purges and then updates; OPTIMIZE compacts the collection.
TYPE
Optional, default "CUSTOM". FILE (one file), PATH (the files of a directory) or CUSTOM (text you supply, usually query columns).
KEY
Optional. FILE: the full path of the file. PATH: the directory to index. CUSTOM: a unique key for the document, or with QUERY the name of the column that holds it (typically the primary key).
TITLE
Optional. CUSTOM only: a literal title, or with QUERY the name of a column. Files get the text of their HTML TITLE tag, or the file name.
BODY
Optional. CUSTOM only: the text to index, or with QUERY a comma-separated list of columns whose values are joined into the document body.
CUSTOM1
Optional. A value stored with each document and returned by CFSEARCH: a literal, or a query column.
CUSTOM2
Optional. A second custom value, like CUSTOM1.
URLPATH
Optional. FILE and PATH: URL prefix; the URL column of a search result is URLPATH plus the file's path relative to the indexed directory. CUSTOM: stored as given.
EXTENSIONS
Optional, default ".htm, .html, .cfm, .cfml, .txt". PATH only: comma-separated extensions to index. Use "*." for files without an extension.
QUERY
Optional. Name of a query. Each row becomes one document (TYPE="CUSTOM").
RECURSE
Optional, default "No". PATH only: Yes also indexes subdirectories.
EXTERNAL
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
LANGUAGE
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.

Usage

For HTML and CFML files, tags, scripts and style sheets are stripped before the text is indexed, and the TITLE becomes the document title. With QUERY, KEY, TITLE, BODY, CUSTOM1 and CUSTOM2 name columns; a name that is not a column is used as literal text.

Indexing happens right away, inside the request. Indexing a large directory on every page view is a good way to make your 56K visitors wait, so index from an administrative page or a scheduled task (CFSCHEDULE), and use CFSEARCH on the public pages.

ACTION="DELETE" works with TYPE="FILE" and TYPE="CUSTOM" (KEY, or KEY plus QUERY). To start over with a directory, use ACTION="REFRESH".

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Make sure the "snippets" collection exists --->
<CFTRY>
  <CFCOLLECTION ACTION="CREATE" COLLECTION="snippets">
<CFCATCH TYPE="Any"><!--- it already does ---></CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>

<CFQUERY NAME="GetCourses" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT Course_ID, Dept_ID, CorName, CorLevel, CorDesc
FROM CourseList
</CFQUERY>

<!--- One document per row; the key is the primary key --->
<CFINDEX COLLECTION="snippets" ACTION="UPDATE" TYPE="CUSTOM"
    QUERY="GetCourses" KEY="Course_ID" TITLE="CorName"
    BODY="CorName,CorDesc" CUSTOM1="Dept_ID" CUSTOM2="CorLevel">

<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Indexed #GetCourses.RecordCount# courses into the collection <B>snippets</B>.
A few of the documents now in it:
</CFOUTPUT>

<CFSEARCH NAME="Peek" COLLECTION="snippets" CRITERIA="*" MAXROWS="6">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Key</TH><TH>Title</TH><TH>Custom1</TH><TH>Custom2</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="Peek">
<TR><TD>#Key#</TD><TD>#Title#</TD><TD>#Custom1#</TD><TD>#Custom2#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>
